parameters.name: product_set_size
parameters.description: Number of products in the finite product set

parameters.name: equipment_set_size
parameters.description: Number of equipment types in the finite equipment set

parameters.name: processing_time
parameters.description: Processing time consumed on each equipment type by each product

parameters.name: available_capacity
parameters.description: Available effective capacity for each equipment type over the planning horizon

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit from the chosen production quantities

variables.name: equipment_usage
variables.description: Total equipment usage on each equipment type

constraints.name: production_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Production quantities must be nonnegative for all products.

constraints.name: equipment_usage_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Equipment usage values must be nonnegative for all equipment types.

constraints.name: capacity_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Available capacity must be nonnegative for all equipment types.

constraints.name: processing_time_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Processing time coefficients must be nonnegative for all equipment types and products.

constraints.name: total_profit_definition
constraints.description: Total profit is the sum of unit profits across all produced quantities.

constraints.name: equipment_capacity_limit_linearized
constraints.description: Total processing time used on each equipment type must not exceed its available capacity.

constraints.name: equipment_usage_definition_linearized
constraints.description: Reported equipment usage equals the total processing time consumed on each equipment type.

constraints.name: total_profit_definition_linearized
constraints.description: Total profit equals the sum of unit profits across all produced quantities.

constraints.name: equipment_capacity_limit_fixed
constraints.description: Total processing time used on each equipment type must not exceed its available capacity.

constraints.name: equipment_usage_definition_fixed
constraints.description: Reported equipment usage equals the total processing time consumed on each equipment type.

objectives.name: total_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit from the chosen production quantities

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit from production quantities, using the scalar total profit variable as the objective value.
